corrections.source_says: other_aid. The control arm used search engines, online resources, and classmates' or friends' knowledge. The form-spec field note puts web search and human partners under other_aid, and the form's own comparison_type (ai_vs_active) already treats this arm as another aid.
corrections.quote: The control group did their hometasks using all available "traditional" sources, i.e. printed books, online resources, classmates' or friends' knowledge, social media channels, search engines, electronic dictionaries, paper dictionaries, etc.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 3 (journal p. 640), Section 2 Materials and methods; form-spec.md field notes, arms[].ai

corrections.form_value: context_class "none"; reason ends "Belongs in the screening report as a small experiment, outside the dataset."
corrections.source_says: observational. Students chose their method (p. 640), the paper never mentions random assignment, and the form's own design_class is quasi_people. Codebook Section 3 puts non-random comparisons of people under observational context, and the form-spec says the dataset folds quasi_people into observational. The codebook's screening-report list of small experiments covers randomized experiments only. Codebook Section 13 leaves this open for Review 1, so the reason can add that only 16 people were analyzed.
corrections.quote: Comparisons of people who work with and without AI under non-random assignment also go here.
corrections.locator: creativity-codebook.md Section 3 (Observational) and Section 13; form-spec.md field notes, design_class; paper PDF p. 3 (journal p. 640)

corrections.form_value: Three outcomes: S1-O1 original thinking, S1-O2 fluency, S1-O3 flexibility. The other Table 2 parameters appear only as names in S1-O2 measure_detail.
corrections.source_says: Table 2 scores eight Guilford characteristics of creativity on each student's start and final texts, and the form lists two of them. Elaboration matches the codebook construct elaboration, and the Results text discusses it. Its start/final pairs: AI 0.5/0.5, 0/1, 0/0, 0.5/1, 0/0, 0.5/1, 0.5/1, 0.5/0.5. Other sources 0.5/1, 0/0.5, 0/0.5, 1/1, 1/1, 1/0.5, 0.5/0.5, 0.5/0.5. Tolerance of ambiguity, breadth of interest, sensitivity, independence, and reflection are also creativity characteristics scored on the output (construct other). With nine such outcomes, rule 7 asks for all of them, or a note that says why some were left out.
corrections.quote: At the same time, three students showed significant progress in fluency and elaboration. Two of them used AI.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 8 (journal p. 645), Table 2 and the paragraph below it; PDF p. 7 (journal p. 644), last paragraph; form-spec.md rule 7

corrections.source_says: The abstract says creative skills were comparatively underdeveloped in the AI group. The Results text and the Conclusion say the reverse for the creativity parameters: more progress in the AI group. The one-line finding rightly follows the body. The form should record the conflict, because the search and triage records repeat the abstract's claim.
corrections.quote: The results showed that critical thinking parameters and creative skills have been comparatively underdeveloped in the experimental group.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 1 (journal p. 638), Abstract; compare PDF p. 8 (journal p. 645), Section 4 text below Table 2 and Section 5 Conclusion

corrections.source_says: ["none"]. The paper prints only per-student start and final scores. It gives no group means, SDs, or tests, and its limitations paragraph says so.
corrections.quote: Limitation of the study also lies in the fact that the results section does not use statistical analysis methods.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 6 (journal p. 643), Section 3 Discussion; form-spec.md field notes, statistics_available

corrections.source_says: no_clear_difference. The text makes no flexibility-specific statement, and the Conclusion's list of parameters where AI users progressed leaves flexibility out. Table 2 shades every flexibility change as insignificant. The AI arm has two pale-green gains (Students 6 and 7) and two orange losses (Students 2 and 4). The other-sources arm has one pale-green gain (Student 9). No flexibility cell is dark green or red.
corrections.quote: Insignificant changes (indicators decreased or increased within half a point) are highlighted in pale green and orange.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 7 (journal p. 644), Section 4 Results (colour legend); PDF p. 8 (journal p. 645), Table 2 and Section 5 Conclusion

corrections.form_value: Three verbatim sentences joined by ellipses, 45 words
corrections.source_says: Form-spec rule 4 caps quotes at 40 words. Dropping the first sentence leaves 32 words and keeps the evidence that students chose their method.
corrections.quote: Students independently chose a way to accomplish a task during semester. ... Once a method of completing an assignment ("AI" or "traditional") was selected during the semester, that method could not be changed.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 3 (journal p. 640), Section 2; form-spec.md rule 4

corrections.form_value: ... on a 0/0.5/1 point scale for four critical-thinking parameters and eight Guilford creativity parameters.
corrections.source_says: Start scores are 0, 0.5, or 1, and the authors add 0.5 or 1 point for improvement. Table 1 therefore holds final scores of 1.5 (erudition for Students 2 and 11, original thinking for Student 10), and the form's own S1-O1 string records 0.5/1.5. Suggested wording: scored 0, 0.5, or 1 point, with 0.5 or 1 point added for improvement.
corrections.quote: If we identified the parameter as one at the basic level and then it was improved, another half-point (0,5) or one (1) point were added to the initial score.
corrections.locator: PDF p. 5 (journal p. 642), Section 2; PDF p. 7 (journal p. 644), Table 1

confirmed: Version, title, authors, and length match: European Journal of Contemporary Education 2024, 13(4): 638-648, DOI 10.13187/ejced.2024.4.638, 11 PDF pages, Ilya Bykov and Irina Gladchenko (PDF p. 1).
The paper mentions no supplement, data or code link, preregistration, or company (PDF pp. 1-11).

No study randomizes people. The word 'random' never appears. Students 'independently chose' their method and could not switch (PDF p. 3, journal p. 640; PDF p. 9, journal p. 646). design_class quasi_people, criterion 1 not_met, and has_randomized_people_study false hold. randomized 'not_stated' is defensible, and 'no' would also fit.

Counts are people: 16 analyzed, 8 AI and 8 other sources (PDF p. 7, journal p. 644, Section 4; Tables 1 and 2 print N = 16). Only 16 students consented to publication, and the paper gives no total (PDF p. 3, journal p. 640). n_randomized null is right. 16 is below 50, so criterion 2 is not_met.

Both scored texts were written in two academic hours without auxiliary materials, and the final text was limited to 500 words (PDF p. 4, journal p. 641). ai_available_when_produced 'no', question after_ai, and criterion 3 met all hold.
S1-O1: all 16 original-thinking start/final pairs match Table 1 (PDF p. 7, journal p. 644). The quoted sentence is verbatim, and treatment_lower matches it.
S1-O2: all 16 fluency start/final pairs match Table 2 (PDF p. 8, journal p. 645). Both quoted sentences are verbatim, and treatment_higher matches them and the Conclusion's list.
S1-O3: all 16 flexibility start/final pairs match Table 2 (PDF p. 8, journal p. 645). Student 10's start is printed 0.5 with a point, and the other cells use decimal commas.

The dark-green cells in Table 2 are Student 2 elaboration and Student 6 fluency (both AI) and Student 11 fluency (other sources). This fits 'three students ... Two of them used AI' (PDF p. 8, journal p. 645).
participants.quote and the three assignment sentences are verbatim (PDF p. 7 and PDF p. 3).

The one-line finding matches the body: significant original-thinking gains in the traditional-resources group (PDF p. 7, journal p. 644), more progress on creativity parameters in the AI group (PDF p. 8, journal p. 645), and no statistical tests (PDF p. 6, journal p. 643).
Locators cite printed journal pages 638-648 (PDF page = journal page minus 637), and each resolves to the right passage.
summary: The form correctly classes c228 as a non-randomized comparison of 16 students (8 AI-only, 8 other sources) who chose their own method, with no randomized study of people, and every per-student score in its three reported strings matches Tables 1 and 2 of the journal PDF. Corrections: the control arm is other_aid, the context class should be observational under the current codebook, elaboration and five other Table 2 creativity outcomes are missing, the abstract's contrary claim on creative skills is not recorded, statistics_available should be ["none"], flexibility's direction should be no_clear_difference, and one over-long quote and the scale description need small fixes.
